messages:
maria: kicking off a short thread: proposal for automating legal-hold retention and an "escape-hatch" workflow for emergency discovery. Need buy-in from security/legal/ops on minimal telemetry and approval traces.

tara: high level ok. security needs tamper-proof retention flags, HSM-signed hold tokens, and scoped access for unhold. Also require audit trail of who requested hold + justification.

kevin: legal wants: (1) signed business justification, (2) timestamped approver chain, (3) immutable hold_id, (4) exportable evidence bundle that ties events to hold. Holds must prevent purge jobs until explicit release.

sam: ops notes: we'll implement hold as a retention override with `hold_id`. purge worker will skip events matching active hold predicates. Need an emergency process to mark a cluster read-only for exports. Also want alerting if hold causes storage spike.

jon: implementation idea: store `hold_ref` in onboarding metadata and write `hold_id` into event index as an opaque token. On export, bundle events + hold receipts + signatures. We'll avoid putting PII in event records.

maria: proposed minimal fields for events when under hold: `event_id`, `ingest_ts`, `tenant_hash`, `retention_label`, `hold_id` (nullable), `tamper_hash`, `ingest_sig`. Also require `hold_manifest` record that contains signer chain and justification stored outside event stream.

tara: add `hold_scope` (global, tenant, resource) and `hold_reason_code`. Security also wants `hold_lifecycle` timestamps (created_at, escalated_at, released_at).

kevin: add requirement: legal hold release must include release_approver and release_reason. Keep release audit immutable.

sam: ops will add metrics: active_holds_count, estimated_hold_storage_bytes, and purge_skipped_count. We'll alert above thresholds.

maria: launch checklist draft: spec merged + examples, hold_manifest storage + access controls, purge worker honor holds + tests, export bundle includes hold receipts, runbook for emergency read-only export, SLO for export time during hold.

junior-engineer: quick Q: who can create a hold? legal only?

kevin: policy: holds created by legal or oncall with legal approval. create requests must be signed.

ops-bot: Note: RFC #848 opened "legal-hold-automation" by maria. CI: spec lint OK.

maria: action items: @jon - PR for event field changes and export bundle, @sam - purge worker tests + metrics, @tara - security controls + HSM token design, @kevin - legal hold policy doc. I'll schedule a 30-min runbook rehearsal with oncall and legal next Tue.
